description: Register a webhook endpoint: a URL where PostFast sends a signed JSON POST for every event of the chosen types, { id, type, timestamp, workspaceId, data }, where data.post is a post as list_posts returns it and data.account an account as list_accounts returns it. The endpoint gets these events from the whole workspace, for every account; a receiver that wants one account checks data.post.socialMediaId (or data.post.platform) or data.account.id. A workspace can have 5 active endpoints (turned-off ones don't count); one more fails with webhook.limitReached. The answer is the endpoint plus secret (whsec_…), shown this once: PostFast never returns it again, so give it to the user and tell them to store it in their receiver now (if it is lost, delete the endpoint and create a new one). The receiver checks every delivery with it as Standard Webhooks specifies: the webhook-id, webhook-timestamp and webhook-signature headers, verified over the raw request body; a Standard Webhooks library such as standardwebhooks does this. A delivery counts when the receiver answers 2xx within 15 seconds; redirects are not followed. Anything else is retried up to 7 more times over about a day (after 5 s, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h, 4 h, 6 h and 7 h). A 410 Gone answer turns the endpoint off at once, and five days of failures with no success turn it off and email the workspace owner. An event can arrive twice and events can arrive out of order, so the receiver should skip an id it has already handled. Offer test_webhook_endpoint to check the receiver.

description.description: A note to tell endpoints apart, such as what the receiver is for (max 255 characters)

events.description: Event types to send, each at most once: post.published (a post was published), post.failed (a post failed for good, with the reason in data.post.lastError; never sent for a failure that will still be retried), account.connected (an account was connected or reconnected; data.reconnected is true for a reconnect, and data.externalId carries the connect link's externalId when it had one) and account.disconnected (PostFast paused an account, for example because its access expired or was revoked). webhook.test can't be chosen: only test_webhook_endpoint sends it.

url.description: The receiver's URL: https on port 443, with a public hostname that contains a dot (no IP address, no localhost or internal name, no user:password@) and resolves to public addresses; at most 2,048 characters. A URL that breaks a rule fails with webhook.urlNotHttps, webhook.urlPortNotAllowed, webhook.urlHostNotAllowed, webhook.urlPrivateAddress (it resolves to a private address), webhook.urlResolutionFailed (the hostname doesn't resolve) or webhook.invalidUrl.
